task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: Tea is one of the most popular drinks in the world, and China is its homeland. According to legend, tea was discovered nearly five thousand years ago. At first it was used as a medicine, and only later did it become a daily drink. For Chinese people, drinking tea is not only a way to quench thirst but also a way to receive guests and relax the mind. Today, tea culture has spread to more than one hundred and sixty countries and regions.
model: 茶是世界上最受欢迎的饮料之一，而中国是茶的故乡。相传，茶是在将近五千年前被发现的。起初它被当作药物使用，后来才成为日常的饮品。对中国人来说，喝茶不仅是解渴的方式，也是招待客人、放松心情的方式。如今，茶文化已经传播到一百六十多个国家和地区。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: In recent years, more and more young people have chosen to return to their hometowns to start businesses. With the help of the internet, they sell local agricultural products to customers all over the country. This trend has not only increased farmers' incomes but also brought new vitality to the countryside. However, problems such as a shortage of funds and a lack of technical support still exist, and further help from the government is needed.
model: 近年来，越来越多的年轻人选择返回家乡创业。借助互联网，他们把当地的农产品卖给全国各地的顾客。这一趋势不仅增加了农民的收入，也给乡村带来了新的活力。然而，资金短缺、缺乏技术支持等问题依然存在，还需要政府进一步的帮助。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. No matter how far away they are, people try their best to return home and have a reunion dinner with their families on New Year's Eve. During the festival, people paste couplets on their doors, set off fireworks and visit relatives and friends. In recent years, some new customs have appeared: many families choose to travel during the holiday, and young people send digital red envelopes by mobile phone.
model: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。无论离家多远，人们都会想方设法回到家中，在除夕夜与家人一起吃团圆饭。节日期间，人们在门上贴春联、放烟花、走亲访友。近年来出现了一些新的习俗：许多家庭选择在假期外出旅游，年轻人则用手机发电子红包。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: Reading on paper is gradually being replaced by reading on screens. A survey shows that last year adults in China spent an average of more than one hundred minutes a day reading on their mobile phones. Digital reading is convenient and inexpensive, and it allows people to make use of fragments of time. However, experts point out that when reading on a screen, people tend to skim rather than think deeply. They therefore suggest that important books should still be read on paper.
model: 纸质阅读正逐渐被屏幕阅读所取代。一项调查显示，去年我国成年人平均每天用手机阅读的时间超过一百分钟。数字阅读方便、便宜，还能让人们利用零碎的时间。不过专家指出，在屏幕上阅读时，人们往往只是浏览，而不是深入思考。因此他们建议，重要的书籍仍然应当读纸质版。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: Bamboo plays an important role in Chinese culture. It grows fast, stays green all year round, and bends in the wind without breaking. For this reason, ancient scholars regarded it as a symbol of modesty and integrity. Bamboo is also widely used in daily life: people make furniture, chopsticks, paper and even houses out of it. Today, as an environmentally friendly material, bamboo is attracting the attention of designers and architects around the world.
model: 竹子在中国文化中占有重要的地位。它生长迅速，四季常青，在风中弯而不折。因此，古代的文人把它看作谦虚和正直的象征。竹子在日常生活中也用途广泛：人们用它制作家具、筷子、纸张，甚至建造房屋。如今，作为一种环保材料，竹子正受到世界各地设计师和建筑师的关注。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: Volunteering has become a new fashion among Chinese university students. At weekends, many of them go to nursing homes to keep elderly people company or teach children in remote areas through online classes. A recent report indicates that more than forty percent of university students took part in volunteer activities last year. Through volunteering, they not only help others but also gain a deeper understanding of society. Nevertheless, some activities are poorly organised and need better management.
model: 志愿服务已成为中国大学生中的一种新风尚。周末，许多学生去养老院陪伴老人，或者通过网络课堂给偏远地区的孩子上课。最近的一份报告显示，去年有超过百分之四十的大学生参加了志愿活动。通过志愿服务，他们不仅帮助了他人，也加深了对社会的了解。不过，有些活动组织得不够好，还需要加强管理。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: The Grand Canal is the longest man-made waterway in the world. It runs from Beijing in the north to Hangzhou in the south, with a total length of nearly one thousand eight hundred kilometres. For more than a thousand years, it was the main route for transporting grain from the south to the capital. Many cities along the canal prospered because of it. Today, some sections are still in use, and the canal has been listed as a World Heritage Site.
model: 大运河是世界上最长的人工水道。它北起北京，南到杭州，全长近一千八百公里。一千多年里，它一直是把南方的粮食运往都城的主要通道。运河沿线的许多城市因它而繁荣。如今，运河的部分河段仍在使用，它已被列入《世界遗产名录》。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: With the ageing of the population, how to care for the elderly has become a concern for the whole of society. Most elderly people in China prefer to spend their later years at home rather than in nursing homes. To meet this need, many communities have set up dining halls and day-care centres for older residents. Some cities have also introduced smart devices that can call for help automatically when an elderly person falls. These measures have greatly eased the burden on families.
model: 随着人口老龄化，如何照顾老年人已成为全社会关心的问题。中国的大多数老人更愿意在家里而不是在养老院度过晚年。为了满足这一需求，许多社区为老年居民开办了食堂和日间照料中心。一些城市还引进了智能设备，老人摔倒时可以自动呼救。这些措施大大减轻了家庭的负担。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: Chinese calligraphy is an ancient art with a history of several thousand years. With only a brush, ink and paper, a calligrapher can express his feelings and personality through the thickness and rhythm of the strokes. In the past, every educated person was expected to write a good hand. Although people now mostly type on keyboards, calligraphy has not disappeared. Many schools offer calligraphy classes, and more and more foreigners are also beginning to learn this art.
model: 中国书法是一门有着数千年历史的古老艺术。书法家只凭一支毛笔、墨和纸，就能通过笔画的粗细和节奏表达自己的情感与个性。过去，每一个读书人都应当写得一手好字。虽然现在人们大多用键盘打字，书法却并没有消失。许多学校开设了书法课，越来越多的外国人也开始学习这门艺术。

task: 请阅读下面的材料（一分钟），然后把它口头翻译成中文（两分钟）。
source: High-speed rail has greatly changed the way Chinese people travel. A journey that once took a whole night can now be completed in four or five hours. By the end of last year, the total length of the high-speed rail network had exceeded forty thousand kilometres, linking almost all large and medium-sized cities. It has not only made travel more comfortable but also promoted economic exchanges between regions. At the same time, how to reduce operating costs remains a challenge.
model: 高铁极大地改变了中国人的出行方式。过去需要一整夜的旅程，现在四五个小时就能完成。截至去年年底，高铁网络的总里程已超过四万公里，连接了几乎所有的大中城市。它不仅使出行更加舒适，也促进了地区之间的经济交流。与此同时，如何降低运营成本仍是一个挑战。
